description: VR180 capture session for tools/stereo_capture.py (one location). The game clock is scripted by LB_VR180, so nothing is slowed with sgtm; tm hides the HUD. LB_STEREO_PASSES=size keeps DXVK's eye offset off square shadow maps, so the face size (the save folder's iSize, see max_prefs.py) must differ from iShadowMapResolution (4096): use 4032.

locations.name: flame180
locations.description: Riverwood flame-in-hand for a stereo 180-degree video: Flames readied in the left hand, iron sword in the right, facing the river. LB_VR180 renders blocks of 16 frames from frame 3150 (see runtime/d3d9_bridge.cpp); the triplet only gives tools/stereo_capture.py an end point and must come after the last block.
